description: Defines the SerialPortEvent class for handling serial port events in the jSSC library, including event type constants and methods to query event details.

classes.name: SerialPortEvent
classes.description: Represents serial port events with properties for port name, event type, and event value, along with methods to identify event types.

methods.name: SerialPortEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with port name, event type, and event value.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the port that generated the event.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getEventValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the event, interpretation depends on event type.

methods.name: isRXCHAR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXCHAR.

methods.name: isRXFLAG
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RXFLAG.

methods.name: isTXEMPTY
methods.description: Checks if the event type is TXEMPTY.

methods.name: isCTS
methods.description: Checks if the event type is CTS.

methods.name: isDSR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is DSR.

methods.name: isRLSD
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RLSD.

methods.name: isBREAK
methods.description: Checks if the event type is BREAK.

methods.name: isERR
methods.description: Checks if the event type is ERR.

methods.name: isRING
methods.description: Checks if the event type is RING.
